thread:
elaine_cs: Hey team — Lithic Payments (pilot) hitting APAC in 24h, they need a temporary egress allowlist + qps bump for onboarding tests. Can we do a 48h exception and auto-revoke?

sam_ops: +1. can you drop the IP ranges and target qps? also flagging renewal risk if latency stays bad in APAC. we should add a canary route fallback to us-east.

elaine_cs: IPs they gave: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/25. Target qps: 1800 steady, spike to 3000 for demo windows. Auto-revoke: 2025-06-12T18:00:00Z. Need TLS passthrough via apac-proxy-1.

junior_se: FYI they said retries are aggressive in the client; asked us to set short 429 backoff and a soft qps ceiling. snippet they sent: ```client.maxRetries=3\nclient.retryBackoffMs=200```

ryan_ae: tagging renewal/health — customer flagged onboarding docs were confusing and they saw 60% higher latency in APAC during earlier test. Elaine, can you capture their feedback in CS notes (esp. docs + sample configs)?

sam_ops: infra request incoming. I'll pin a fallback route policy: if apac latency > 400ms for 2m, route to model-variant-us-east-1-small. Also will add a temporary rate-limit window: increase token qps by +3x for the listed IPs for 48h. Need billing approval for burst credits.

infra-bot: Request created: REQ-2025-9082 — allowlist add (203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.0/25), qps bump to 3000 spike, auto-revoke 2025-06-12T18:00:00Z. Assigned: sam_ops.

elain_cs: small correction: scorecard needs a note — onboarding NPS comment: "docs unclear about proxy headers and IP-based qps exceptions". Adding to ticket.

sam_ops: Done. Applied allowlist to apac-egress-proxy cluster and set soft qps ceiling rules. Added canary fallback. Will monitor metrics dashboard and post an alert if SLOs degrade. Billing tagged for credits. :thumbsup:

junior_se: Thanks — pushed updated quickstart snippet to them with proxy examples and a note about exponential backoff.

elaine_cs: Great — leaving a 1:1 with them after the demo to capture any remaining enablement gaps. marking this thread resolved once auto-revoke exists and we see <1% 5xx during demo window.

sam_ops: Closing checklist: allowlist live, fallback pinned, billing flagged, CS feedback captured. I'll post post-mortem if anything unexpected. :white_check_mark:
